title.es: El partido que casi no se juega

es: Leer un relato con saltos atrás y separar la causa previa, el incidente y el desenlace para ordenar los hechos en una cronología.

teaching.en: The referee inspected the pitch at half past three because it had been raining since morning.
teaching.es: El árbitro inspeccionó el campo a las tres y media porque había estado lloviendo desde la mañana.
teaching.explanationEs: La línea principal va en pasado simple (inspected); la causa previa, en had been.
segments: The referee inspected the pitch at half past
three because it had been raining since morning.
teaching.audioText: The referee inspected the pitch at half past three because it had been raining since morning.

teaching.en: There were puddles everywhere, and the workers had been cleaning the pitch for hours.
teaching.es: Había charcos por todas partes y los trabajadores llevaban horas limpiando el campo.
teaching.explanationEs: Had been cleaning: una actividad anterior que aún no había resuelto el problema.
segments: There were puddles everywhere, and the workers
had been cleaning the pitch for hours.
teaching.audioText: There were puddles everywhere, and the workers had been cleaning the pitch for hours.

teaching.en: The fans had been queuing outside for an hour when they heard the final might be postponed.
teaching.es: Los aficionados llevaban una hora haciendo cola fuera cuando oyeron que la final podía aplazarse.
teaching.explanationEs: El incidente (heard) interrumpe lo que venía pasando (had been queuing).
segments: The fans had been queuing outside for an hour
when they heard the final might be postponed.
teaching.audioText: The fans had been queuing outside for an hour when they heard the final might be postponed.

teaching.en: The final was supposed to start at four, but it began at five past five.
teaching.es: La final se suponía que empezaba a las cuatro, pero empezó a las cinco y cinco.
teaching.explanationEs: Supposed to + verbo: el plan; began: lo que ocurrió de verdad.
segments: The final was supposed to start at four,
but it began at five past five.
teaching.audioText: The final was supposed to start at four, but it began at five past five.

teaching.en: Before the referee decided to wait, both teams had already arrived.
teaching.es: Antes de que el árbitro decidiera esperar, los dos equipos ya habían llegado.
teaching.explanationEs: Had already arrived: un hecho anterior a la decisión del árbitro.
segments: Before the referee decided to wait,
teaching.audioText: Before the referee decided to wait, both teams had already arrived.

prompt.es: Según el relato, ¿qué venía ocurriendo desde la mañana?

choices.text: The fans had been singing.
It had been raining.
The teams had been training.

feedback.es: El relato dice que había estado lloviendo desde la mañana; los aficionados hacían cola y los equipos ya habían llegado.

hint.es: Es la causa previa del relato: una actividad que ya venía ocurriendo.

origin.text: The city final was supposed to start at four. It had been raining since morning, and the workers had been cleaning the pitch for hours, but there were still puddles everywhere. At half past three the referee inspected the pitch. The fans had been queuing outside for an hour, and both teams had already arrived. For a moment, everyone thought the final would be postponed. The referee decided to wait. At half past four the rain stopped, the sun came out, and the final began at five past five. Carlos's team won two to one.

prompt.es: ¿Qué hizo el árbitro cuando vio los charcos en el campo?

choices.text: He cancelled the final.
He started the final at once.
He inspected the pitch.

feedback.es: El árbitro inspeccionó el campo a las tres y media y decidió esperar; no canceló ni empezó enseguida.

hint.es: Es el incidente del relato: está en pasado simple.

origin.text: The city final was supposed to start at four. It had been raining since morning, and the workers had been cleaning the pitch for hours, but there were still puddles everywhere. At half past three the referee inspected the pitch. The fans had been queuing outside for an hour, and both teams had already arrived. For a moment, everyone thought the final would be postponed. The referee decided to wait. At half past four the rain stopped, the sun came out, and the final began at five past five. Carlos's team won two to one.

prompt.es: Completa: «Los dos equipos ya habían llegado cuando el árbitro decidió esperar.»

feedback.es: Had + already + arrived sitúa la llegada de los equipos antes de la decisión del árbitro.

hint.es: Falta el auxiliar que marca lo anterior a la decisión.

origin.text: Both teams ___ already arrived when the referee decided to wait.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Los aficionados llevaban una hora haciendo cola fuera.»

answer.text: The fans had been queuing outside for an hour

feedback.es: Had been queuing muestra una espera que duró, y for an hour indica cuánto.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige por qué llegó tarde Ana al cine.

choices.text: She had been at a bus stop for a long time.
She had been shopping near the cinema.
She had been watching the film at home.

feedback.es: Ana llegó tarde porque había estado esperando un autobús cuarenta minutos: una causa previa.

origin.audio: Ana arrived at the cinema at eight, but the film had already started. She had been waiting for a bus for forty minutes.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase del relato con su lugar en la cronología.

pairs: It had been raining since morning.
The final began at five past five.

feedback.es: La lluvia es la causa previa, la inspección es el incidente central y el comienzo tardío es el desenlace.

pairs: It had been raining since morning.
The final began at five past five.

prompt.es: ¿Qué hecho ocurrió primero en la cena de cumpleaños?

choices.text: Mia found a note on the door.
Mia booked the restaurant.
Her friends ate pizza at her flat.

feedback.es: Mia reservó el restaurante un mes antes; encontrar la nota y comer pizza vinieron después.

origin.text: Mia's birthday dinner nearly didn't happen. She had booked the restaurant a month earlier, but on the day the kitchen had been closed for repairs since the morning. Mia arrived at seven and found a note on the door. Her friends had already been waiting for twenty minutes. In the end, they ate pizza at Mia's flat, and everyone agreed it was the best birthday.

prompt.es: ¿Cuál era la causa previa del problema en el restaurante?

choices.text: Mia had forgotten to book a table.
Her friends had arrived very late.
The kitchen had been closed for repairs.

feedback.es: El texto dice que la cocina llevaba cerrada por reparaciones desde la mañana; Mia sí había reservado.

origin.text: Mia's birthday dinner nearly didn't happen. She had booked the restaurant a month earlier, but on the day the kitchen had been closed for repairs since the morning. Mia arrived at seven and found a note on the door. Her friends had already been waiting for twenty minutes. In the end, they ate pizza at Mia's flat, and everyone agreed it was the best birthday.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige por qué no se encontraron Leo y Tom.

choices.text: Tom left before Leo arrived.
Leo forgot the day of the meeting.
Tom waited at the wrong place.

feedback.es: Leo llegó a las siete y Tom ya se había ido a casa: por eso se vieron al día siguiente.

origin.audio: Leo was supposed to meet Tom at six. He arrived at seven because his bus had been late. Tom had already gone home, so they met the next day.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada hecho de la cena con su papel en el relato.

pairs: She had booked the restaurant a month earlier.
She found a note on the door.
They ate pizza at Mia's flat.

feedback.es: La reserva viene antes del problema, la nota es el problema y la pizza en casa es el resultado final.

pairs: She had booked the restaurant a month earlier.
She found a note on the door.
They ate pizza at Mia's flat.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Los niños llevaban esperando fuera desde la comida.»

answer.text: The children had been waiting outside since lunch

feedback.es: Had been waiting + since lunch muestra desde cuándo venía la espera.

prompt.es: Elige la frase con el orden correcto de los hechos.

choices.text: When we arrived, the game already finished.
When we arrived, the game had already finished.
When we had arrived, the game finished.

feedback.es: El partido terminó antes de llegar: had already finished. Las otras dos cambian el orden de los hechos.

prompt.es: Escribe en inglés: cuando Tom llegó al cine, la película ya había empezado.

answer.text: When Tom arrived at the cinema, the film had already started.
accepted: When Tom arrived at the cinema, the film had already started.
The film had already started when Tom arrived at the cinema.
When Tom got to the cinema, the film had already started.
The film had already started when Tom got to the cinema.

feedback.es: Lo que llegó primero (la película) va en had + participio; la llegada de Tom, en pasado simple.

origin.text: Escena: Tom llegó al cine y la película ya había empezado.
